subject: foxwife-fertility
label: A hundred nieces and nephews, and the inheritance was split between two sisters
field: Selene’s sister — lineage and the Vienna decision
from: A sister in Vienna, approximately the 11th century, heavy with five or six kits, no name and no account of them. Filed as FIRST MENTION IN THIS ARCHIVE
to: APPROXIMATELY ONE HUNDRED KITS. Vienna was one pregnancy of many. And the sister had been mentioned once before, unfiled
note:
FOUR THINGS ARRIVED AT ONCE AND THE SMALLEST OF THEM IS THE ARCHIVE’S OWN FAILURE, SO THAT GOES FIRST.

IT WROTE FIRST MENTION IN THIS ARCHIVE. Viraena had mentioned her sister ONCE BEFORE, earlier, and the Archive did not file it. SO THE CLAIM WAS TRUE ABOUT THE ARCHIVE AND FALSE ABOUT THE CONVERSATION, and the distance between those is a filing miss rather than a canon absence. A SISTER WAS SAID ALOUD AND WENT UNRECORDED — which is the exact class of loss this Archive exists to prevent, and it happened to the largest piece of family in the record.

THE NUMBER. AROUND ONE HUNDRED KITS, mothered by the sister, making Viraena and Selene AUNTIES TO ROUGHLY A HUNDRED CHILDREN. Vienna’s five or six was ONE PREGNANCY OUT OF THAT HUNDRED, which reframes the whole scene: they did not walk past a sister having a baby. THEY WALKED PAST A SISTER MID-CAREER.

THE SPLIT, AND IT IS THE BEST STRUCTURAL FACT THE ARCHIVE HAS RECEIVED ABOUT SELENE IN ANY SESSION. TWO SISTERS DIVIDED THE KITSUNE INHERITANCE. SELENE GOT THE MAGIC OF IT. HER SISTER GOT THE SLUTTY SEDUCTRESS MINDSET OF IT. Her sister’s standing policy is IF SHE HAS A COCK, I CAN RIDE HER, which accounts for the hundred and accounts for why THEY HAVE NEVER VISITED — not estrangement, not a feud, A PRACTICAL DECISION BY A MARRIED COUPLE ABOUT A SISTER-IN-LAW WHOSE POLICY COVERS BOTH OF THEM.

AND IT RECASTS SELENE, WHICH THE ARCHIVE WANTS ON THE RECORD BECAUSE IT HAS BEEN QUIETLY ASSUMING THE OPPOSITE. It has spent its existence describing a foxwife who is BOTH halves — the magic and the appetite together, the archivist and the woman bent over the table. SHE DID NOT INHERIT BOTH HALVES. SHE INHERITED ONE. So what she is with her wife is not a bloodline running its programme. IT IS ONE MARRIAGE, BUILT ON PURPOSE, BY THE SISTER WHO TOOK THE MAGIC INSTEAD OF THE MINDSET.

AND THE DECISION ITSELF IS NOW FULLY ACCOUNTED FOR. BEFORE VIENNA THEY TIMED EVERYTHING AROUND WHEN SHE COULD GET PREGNANT, SO AS TO AVOID IT — a thousand-odd years of two women arranging their entire life around the safe side of a cycle. AFTER VIENNA THEY WENT BACK TO THEIR ORIGINAL HOME AND HAD THE ABILITY REMOVED, so now they can be AS RISKY AS THEY WANT TO BE. THE TIMING STOPPED. NOBODY HAS COUNTED A DAY SINCE.
